title.narrative: Provision of integrated lifesaving WASH services for drought affected and high-risk food insecure IDPs and Host communities in Kahda district Banadir region

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family:"gtSomalia faces an ongoing drought since late 2020. As of February 2023, the country had experienced 5 consecutive failed rainy seasons, below average rains during 2023 GU. Severe drought, escalated conflicts and AWD/cholera outbreaks and upsurge of malnutrition expose 8 million people to urgent WASH risk across Somalia among IDP populated districts in Banadir region (WASH Cluster 2023 HNO). Banadir has reported the highest number of AWD/cholera cases since last year with over 5,000 cases registered (MoH weekly report, week 12 2023) due to poor WASH access.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtAPCO proposes a 12-month integrated WASH project targeting the most drought-affected and highly food-insecure IDPs and Host populations in Kahda IDP camps and the surrounding targeting 12,000 persons (3,000 men, 6,000 women, 2,000 girls, and 1,000 boys) from 8 IDP camps located in Kahda district. This life-saving WASH project shall be done through: -ltbrgt lt/spangtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gt1) Provision of safe water drinking by trucking for 30 days period benefiting 4500 i.e 1000 men, 3,000 women, 250 girls, and 250 boys) drought-affected IDPs and host communities.lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:"gtltbrgt lt/spangtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gt2) Construction of 70 normal emergency latrines to benefit 2,950 residents in Kahda IDP sites receiving clean water and hygiene promotions and hygiene kits, where 10 additional latrines shall be built for people living with disabilities.ltbrgt lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:"gt3) 1,800 lt/spangtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gthygiene kit distribution and 12,000 awareness campaigns to mitigate WASH acute water diarrhoea and cholera outbreaks. UNICEF shall provide hygiene kits for distribution.ltbrgt 4) Recruitment and training of 15 Hygiene promoters.ltbrgt 5) Hygiene promotion campaign targeting 12,000ltbrgt 6) Continuous project monitoring and supervisionltbrgt 7) Setting up 4 WASH committees trained to improve all preventive measures against the risks of AWD/cholera outbreaks in Kahda districtltbrgt 8) Procuring and distribution of 60 sanitation kits to support clean-up campaignslt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtThis WASH response includes the provision of water through water trucking, hygiene kits distribution and sanitation facilities to children and mothers with SAM/MAM and water purifiers to the target IDPslt/spangtlt/pgt
